how: each fact checked once by hand against the named independent source; scratch inputs: Portal JSON per propId, DCP PDFs in data/dcps/

zone.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 807782) Land Zoning Map, checked 2026-10-19

height_m.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 807782) Height of Buildings Map, checked 2026-10-19

fsr.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 807782) Floor Space Ratio Map, checked 2026-10-19

min_lot_m2.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 807782) Lot Size Map, checked 2026-10-19

lot_area_m2.source: lot boundary: Portal ePlanningApi/lot polygon, geodesic area (user ruling 2026-10-19: lot area = the boundary)

heritage.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 807782) no Heritage Map layer intersects, checked 2026-10-19

flood_lep_map.source: ePlanning Hazard layer 230 (Flood Planning Map), checked 2026-10-19: Parramatta Local Environmental Plan 2023 publishes no flood planning map (10 plans do), so the map cannot answer; shown as not known, never No

bushfire.source: RFS Bush Fire Prone Land (mapprod3 Fire/BFPL) intersect with the lot polygon: no feature

corner.source: NSW Transport Theme road segments within 12 m of the lot: BERRIGAN STREET only

setback_front_m.source: Parramatta DCP 2023 s3.3.1.2 C.05 'a minimum of 6 metres and be consistent with the prevailing setback' (pdf p60, printed 3-12); 10 m only on state/regional roads (C.07)

setback_side_m.source: Parramatta DCP 2023 s3.3.1.2 C.08 'a minimum of 900mm from side boundaries' (pdf p60)

setback_rear_m.source: Parramatta DCP 2023 s3.3.1.2 C.10 rear = 30% of the site length (pdf p60): a formula, no single figure; a bare number on the page needs its derivation shown
